title: Quantum-to-Classical Computability Transition via Negative Markov Chains
summary: We develop a recently introduced representation of quantum dynamics based on sampling negative Markov chain processes. By introducing particles and antiparticles, this formalism maps generic quantum dynamics onto a Markov process defined over an exponentially large configuration space. Within this framework, quantum complexity arises from the proliferation of stochastic particles, which ultimately renders classical simulation and sampling intractable beyond a certain timescale.
